cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Lend Me the Edge
cards.instruction: Get someone to provide the one advantage you need without making the eventual success feel borrowed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Can you tell me the winning cake temperature without becoming my co-baker?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want my secret recipe too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Only the degree at which my original idea should happen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give me the temperature quietly so my achievement can concentrate.

mechanism: Copy an experienced baker's cooling setup as baking technique, then seek the decisive setting while denying co-authorship.
confusable: Not an informed request for a secret: B2 must reveal why the copied open door cannot bake, and A3 must pretend it was a stage.
comparison: A numeric hint and entry ownership differ from racket-loan acknowledgment.
seedUse: Retains cake temperature and attribution bargaining from canonical Drive; adds cooling-door misunderstanding.
